The comparison table: the Gemini API (Google AI Studio) authenticates with an API key (or OAuth), the Agent Platform with a Google Cloud service account and IAM; the platform lists customer-managed encryption keys, data residency, 'Enhanced security through Virtual Private Cloud' and '24/7 enterprise-level support and SLAs', which the Gemini API column does not; regulated customers should move to the platform, which supports certifications such as HIPAA and SOC2.
Every organization, person, count and deadline is invented teaching data; tool output is an authored rendering in the tool style.

brief.situation: You lead the AI program at Ashby Mutual Health (fictional). The claims assistant pilot was built in Google AI Studio by an innovation team: it calls the Gemini API with one API key stored in the app's settings. It works well, and it goes to production at 17:00 with member claims data. Compliance needs customer-managed keys, US data residency, role-based access and an SLA. It is 16:05.
handover: The company already runs workloads in a Google Cloud organization with IAM, CMEK and audit logging.
The prompts and code are ready; only where and how the model is called would change.
howItWorks: Pick a step from the action list: look, change, check or ship. Nothing you pick is typed or executed: every step shows an authored result.
Each step takes working minutes, and the clock moves by the minutes it takes. The deadline runs on the same clock.
Shipping is final for this case. Afterwards you record what you found and explain your reasoning.

scoring.modelReasoning: Compare the pilot with the controls: it calls the Gemini API with a single API key, so there are no customer-managed keys, no residency setting, no role-based access and no SLA. Those are Google Cloud platform features, so production should call the same model through the Agent Platform in the company project with a service account, CMEK, a US region and the enterprise SLA, then re-check the controls and the regression prompts. OAuth adds identity only; rotating the key changes nothing compliance asked for.
